a: अवकाश् — {c1c} {c4c} A. To be visible, to be manifest. --Caus. To cause to look at.

m: अव-काश m. (ifc. f(आ). ) place, space

room, occasion, opportunity, (अवकासां √ 1. कृ or दा to make room, give way, admit, ŚBr. &c.; अवकाशं √ लभ् or आप्, to get a footing, obtain a favourable opportunity, Śak. &c.; to find scope, happen take place; अवकाशं √ रुध्, not to give way, hinder, Megh.).
aperture, Suśr. (˚शेन instr. ind. between, PBr.)
intermediate time, ŚBr.
‘a glance cast on anything’, N. of certain verses, during the recitation of which the eyes must be fixed on particular objects (which therefore are called अवकाश्य, q.v.), ŚBr.; KātyŚr.
a: अवकाशः — 1 Occasion, opportunity; ताते चापद्वितीये वहति रणधुरां को भयस्यावकाशः Ve. 3. 5; उत्तरावकाशमपाहरंत्या K. 204, 265; साहाय्यदानावकाशः Dk. 96; M. 3. 13; M. 2; oft. used with लभ् in the sense of ‘to get an opportunity or scope for action’; लब्धावकाशोऽ विध्यन्मां तत्र दग्धो मनोभवः Ks. 1. 41. --2 (a) Place, space, room; अवकाशं किलोदन्वान्रामायाभ्यर्थितो ददौ R. 4. 58; अन्यमवकाशमवगाहे V. 4; Ms. 3. 207; यथावकाशं नी to take to its proper place, R. 6. 14; अस्माकमस्ति न कथंचिदिहावकाशः Pt. 4. 8; अवकाशो विविक्तोयं महानद्योः समागमे Rām.; सदोषावकाश इव ते वाक्यशेषः V. 3 your unfinished sentence shows that there is room to find fault. (b) Footing, admission, scope, access, entrance; (छाया) शुद्धे तु दर्पणतले सुलभावकाशा Ś. 7. 32; oft. used in these senses with लभ्; लब्धावकाशा मे प्रार्थना, लब्धावकाशो मे मनोरथः Ś. 1; शोकावेगदूषिते मे मनसि विवेक एव नावकाशं लभते Prab.; also with कृ or दा ‘to make room for’, ‘admit’, ‘give way to’; असौ हि दत्वा तिमिरावकाशं Mk. 3. 6; तस्माद्देयो विपुलमतिभिर्नावकाशोऽधमानां Pt. 1. 366; शयने दत्तोऽ वकाशः Amaru. 18; अदत्तावकाशो मत्सरस्य K. 45 not swayed by malice; Ms. 9. 271; Y. 2. 276; ददौ च निजचित्तेपि सोवकाशं मनोभुवः Ks. 20. 71; K. 132, 141, 207; Ratn. 2. 14; अवकाशं रुध् to obstruct, hinder or impede; नयनसलिलोत्पीडरुद्धावकाशां (निद्रां) Me. 91. --3 Interval, intermediate space or time. --4 An aperture, opening. --5 A glance cast on anything. --6 N. of certain verses during the recitation of which the eyes must be fixed upon certain objects.

m: अव-काश—द mfn. giving opportunity, granting the use of (in comp.), Mn. ix, 271 and 278; Yājñ. ii, 276.
अव-काश—वत् (अवकास-) mfn. spacious, ŚBr.
a: अवकाशवत् — a. Spacious.

अव-काशेन ind., between, PBr.
अव-काश्य mfn. ‘to be looked at’, admitted in the recitation of the Avakāśa verses, KātyŚr.
a: अवकाश्य — a. Admitted in the recitation of the Avakāśa verses.

m: अवकाद mfn. eating the above plant, AV. iv, 37, 8-10.

अव-√ कॄ -किरति (impf. अवाकिरत्; ind.p. -कीर्य) to pour out or down, spread, scatter, ĀśvGṛ. &c.; (Pot. -किरेत्) to spill one's semen virile, TĀr. (cf. अव-कीर्ण and ˚र्णिन् below); to shake off, throw off, leave, TBr.; MBh.; to bestrew, pour upon, cover with, fill, MBh. &c.: Pass. -कीर्यते (perf. -चक्रे, MBh. iii, 12306, according to Pāṇ. iii, 1, 87 Comm. also Ā. -किरते aor. अवाकिर्ष्ट) to extend in different directions, disperse, pass away, MBh. &c.; Ā. (aor. 3. pl. अवाकीर्षत) to fall off, become faithless, PBr., (cf. अव-√ स्-कॄ)
a: अवकॄ — {c6c} P. 1 To bestow, pour upon, to shower upon, cover with, fill; Śi. 11. 62; (तं) अवाकिरन् बाललताः प्रसूनैः R. 2. 10, 4. 27; लाजांजलिभिरवकीर्यमाणः K. 86; Ki. 6. 2; अवकीर्योत्तरीयाणि Mb. spreading on the ground; तीर्थानि अवकीर्णानि तपस्विभिः Mb. filled with; Y. 3. 281; Me. 54. --2 To pour out, throw out Ms. 6. 48. --3 To shake off, throw off, leave. --4 (Atm.) (Used reflexively) (a) To extend, spread itself; अवकिरते हस्ती स्वयमेव Sk. (b) To fall asunder. (c) To pass away, fall off. (d) To become faithless or untrue.

v: tri॰ ava + kfza--kta । 1 dUrokfte 2 apasArite, 3 vahizkArite ca । avakfzwaM gfhAvakarAderavakarzaRamastyasya arSa॰ ac । 4 gfhAvakaramArjake dAsaBede pu॰ । “paRodeyo'vakfzwasya zaqutkfzwasya vetanam । zARmAsikastaTAcCAdo DAnya droRastu mAsikaH” manuH । “avakfzwasya gfhAdisaMmArjakodakAdivAhAdeH karmmakarasya kullU” 0 ।
m: अव-कृष्ट mfn. dragged down, being underneath anything (in comp.), Suśr.
‘removed’, being at some distance, KātyŚr.
(also compar. अवकृष्ट-तर mfn. ‘farther off from’ [abl.] Comm. on APrāt.)
inferior, low, outcast, Mn. vii, 126 & viii, 177; Yājñ. iii, 262, &c.
a: अवकृष्ट — p. p. 1 Drawn away or down, pulled down. --2 Removed. --3 Expelled, turned out or away. --4 Inferior, low, degraded, outcast (opp. उत्कृष्ट or प्रकृष्ट); ˚जातिः Ms. 8. 177; प्रतिकर्तुं प्रकृष्टस्य नावकृष्टेन युज्यते Rām. --ष्टः A servant who performs the lowest menial duties (such as sweeping &c.) ( संमार्जनशोधनविनियुक्त); पणो देयोऽवकृष्टस्य षडुत्कृष्टस्य वेतनं Ms. 7. 126.

k.v: तूष्णींशीलस्तु तूष्णीको नग्नोऽवासा दिगम्बरे। निष्कासितोऽवकृष्टः स्यादपध्वस्तस्तु धिक्कृतः॥

m: अव-कृष्ट—तर mfn., compar., ‘farther off from’ [abl.] Comm. on APrāt.

v: tri॰ ava + kfza karmmaRi kyap । 1 AkazarRIye 2 dUrIkAryye ava + kfza lyap । 3 AkfzyetyarTe avya॰ ।

m: अवकिन् mfn. filled with Avakā plants Comm. on KātyŚr.
अव-किरण See अव- √ 1. कॄ.
अव-किरण n. sweepings, Car.

v: pu॰ ava + klida--BAve GaY । pAkottaraM klede (pacA haoyA) kledaSca jalaviSezasaMyogena vastuno nASajanakaH avayavasaMyogaSETilyasaMpAdako vyApAraH ।
m: अव-क्लेद, m. or अव-क्लेदन, n. trickling, descent of moisture, L. fetid discharge, L.
a: अवक्लेदः — 1 Trickling, descent of moisture. --2 Ichor.
अवक्लेदनं — Trickling, falling (as dew or moisture).

v: tri॰ ava + klida--kta । pAkAdaDastAt 1 klinne (pacA) 1 PalAdO jalAdinA 2 atyantArdreca । pUrvvaM pakvaMtato'vaklinnaM rAja॰ pUrvvani॰ । avaklinnapakvam ।
a: अवक्लिन्न — a. Wet, thoroughly wet.

m: अवक्लिन्न-पक्व mfn. trickling because of being over-ripe, (g. राजदन्तादि, q.v.)

v: tri॰ avakruzwaH kIkilayA prA॰ sa॰ । kokilayA kuzwe ।
m: अव-कोकिल mfn. (= अवक्रुष्टः कोकिलया) called down to by the koïl (singing in a tree above ?), Pāṇ. ii, 2, 18 Comm.
a: अवकोकिल — a. [अवक्रुष्टः कोकिलया] Drawn or called down to by a cuckoo.

m: अवकोल्ब mf(आ)n. covered or surrounded with Avakā plants, AV. viii, 7, 9.
अवकोल्ब See अवक.

a: अवक्रांतिः — f. 1 Descending, descent. --2 Approach.

m: अव-क्रामिन् mfn. running away, AV. v, 14, 10.
a: अवक्रामिन् — a. Ved. Running away, escaping.

m: अव-क्रान्ति f. id., ib.
अव-√ क्री only Ā. -क्रिणीते (Pāṇ. i, 3, 18; but also P. Pot. -क्रीणीयात्, BṛĀrUp., [अप-क्रीणीयात्, ŚBr. xiv]; ind.p. -क्रीय, ŚāṅkhŚr.) to purchase for one's self hire, bribe.
a: अवक्री — {c9c} U. 1 To purchase. --2 To let out, hire. --3 To bribe, buy off.

m: अव-√ क्रीड् Ā. to play (?), L.

v: tri॰ viroDe na॰ ta॰ । vakratAviroDini sAralyayukte ।
m: अ-वक्र mfn. not crooked, straight, ĀśvŚr. &c.
upright, honest.
a: अवक्र — a. Not crooked, straight; (fig.) honest, upright.
अवक्रंद् — {c1c} U. To cry out, roar.
अवक्रंद — a. Crying slowly, roaring, neighing. --दः A cry.
अवक्रंदनं — Crying out, weeping aloud.

m: अ-वक्र-गमिता f. having a straight gait (one of the 80 minor marks of a Buddha), Dharmas. 84.

v: tri॰ ava + kfza Rini pf॰ । akarzaRaSIMle “avakrakziRaM vfzaBaM yaTA juram” f॰ 8, 1, 2, avakrakziRamavakarzaRaSIlam” BA॰ ।
m: अव-क्रक्षिन् mfn. (cf. क्रक्षमाण) rushing down, RV. viii, 1, 2.
a: अवक्रक्षिन् — [अव-कृष् णिनि पृ˚] Dashing down, overcoming; अवक्रक्षिणं वृषभं यथा जुरम् Rv. 8. 1. 2.

m: अव-√ क्रम् (Opt., -क्रामेत्) to step down upon (acc.), TĀr.; (aor. 3. pl. -क्रमुः [cf. Pāṇ. vi, 1, 116]; pr. p. क्रामत्) to tread down, overcome, RV. vi, 75, 7 and vii, 32, 27; VS.; AV.; ŚBr.; to descend (into a womb), Buddh.; Jain. : Caus. (p. -क्रमयत्) to cause to go down, KātyŚr.
a: अवक्रम् — {c1c} U., {c4c} P. 1 To step down or away, run away, escape, withdraw. --2 To tread down, overcome; वज्रेणैवेनमवक्रामति Śat. Br. --3 To descend, come down. --Caus. To cause to go down.

v: pu॰ ava + krama--BAve GaY । avakramaRe nimnagatO
a: अवक्रमः — Descending, descent.

m: अव-क्रमण n. descending (into a womb), conception, Buddh.; Jain.
अव-√ क्रन्द् (Imper. -क्रन्दतु, 2. sg. -क्रन्द; aor. -चक्रदत्, 2. sg.: चक्रदस्) to cry out, roar, RV. Caus. (aor. अचिक्रदत्) to rush down upon (acc.) with a loud cry, RV. ix, 75, 3.

v: tri॰ ava + kranda karttari ac । 1 nIzEH krandanaSIle “krandate svAhA'vakrandAya svAhA” ya॰ 227 । BAve GaY nocEH 2 krandane pu॰ । BAve lyuw avakrandanamapyatra na॰ ।
m: अव-क्रन्द m. roaring, neighing, VS. xxii, 7 and xxv, 1.
अव-क्रन्दन n. crying, weeping aloud, L.

s: avakrayaH

puM, (avakrIyate pratirUpadAnena svADInaM kriyate'nena, ava + krI + ac .) krayasADanadravyaM । mUlyaM । ityamaraH ॥ (rAjagrAhyaM dravyaM । baRigBiH SuklasTAne pratiBARqamaDipataye deyaM ! “vikrayAvakrayADAnayAcitezu paRAn daSa” । iti yAjYavalkyaH । etAvatkAlamupayogArTaM BARqavastrASvAdirmmayA dIyate mahyaM ca yuzmABiretAbadDanaM deyamityevaMviDaM BAwakaM । BAqA iti BAzA .)
v: pu॰ avakrIyate pratirUpadAnena svAGInaM kriyate'nena ava + krI--ac । grAhyasya pratirUpatvena deye 1 mUlye 2 BAwake ca mAwakaYca gfhavastrAdivastunaH etAvat upaBoge DanaM grAhya miti samayena parAyattIkaraRam karaRe'c । 3 tat sADane dravye SuklAdisTAne vaRigBirnfpAya deye (mAsula) 4 kare ca ।
m: अव-क्रय m. letting out to hire, Yājñ. ii, 238
rent, revenue, Pāṇ. iv, 4, 50.
a: अवक्रयः — 1 Price. --2 Wages, hire, farm, rent. --3 Letting out to hire, leasing; Y. 2. 238. --4 A tax or tribute (to be paid to the king), duty ( राजग्राह्यं द्रव्यं Sk.).

k.v: विक्रेता स्याद्विक्रयिकः क्रायकक्रयिकौ समौ। वाणिज्यं तु वणिज्या स्यान्मूल्यं वस्नोऽप्यवक्रयः॥

m: अव-क्रिया f. non-performance of prescribed acts, L.
अव-क्रिया See अव- √ 1. कृ.
a: अवक्रिया — Neglect, omission, nonperformance of prescribed acts.

m: अव-क्रोश m. a discordant noise, L.
an imprecation, L.
abuse, L.
a: अवक्रोशः — 1 Discordant noise. --2 A curse. --3 Abuse, censure.
अवक्रुश् — {c1c} P. To call down to; to revile.

v: tri॰ ava + kruSa--karmmaRi kta । kftAkroSe yamuddiSya kroSaH kftastasmin । “avakruzwaH kokilayA” si॰ kO॰ ।
m: अव-क्रुष्ट mfn. ‘called down to’, see अव-कोकिल.
a: अवक्रुष्ट — p. p. Sounded ill or badly, reviled, censured.

s: avaktavyaM
tri, (na vaktavyaM, naYsamAsaH .) vacanAyogyaM । akaTanIyaM । na vaktavyaM avaktavyamiti naYsamAsanizpannaM । yaTA, -- “asamBAvyaM na vaktavyaM pratyakzamapi dfSyate” । iti cARakyaH ॥
v: tri॰ na vaktavyaH । 1 vaktumanarhe aSlIlAdO vAkye 2 nizidDavacane 3 miTyABUtte ca ।
m: अ-वक्तव्य mfn. not to be said, indescribable, NṛsUp. &c.
a: अवक्तव्य — a. 1 Not fit to be uttered, improper. --2 Censurable (as a saying). --3 False. --4 Indescribable, inexpressible.

m: अ-वक्तृ mfn. who does not speak, MaitrUp.

v: tri॰ nAsti vaktraM yatra । suSrutokte SoRitAdinismAraRa muKaSUnye braRAdO “antaHpUyezvavaktrezu taTEvotsaNgavatsvapi । netravartmagudAByAsanAqyo'vaktrAH saSoRitAH” ।
m: अ-वक्त्र mf(आ)n. having no mouth (as a vessel), Suśr.
a: अवक्त्र — a. Having no opening (as a vessel, wound &c.).
अवकुंठनं — 1 Investing, surrounding. --2 Attracting, engaging.
अवकुंठित — a. 1 Invested, surrounded. --2 Attracted.
अवकुंचनं — 1 Bending, curving, contraction. --2 A kind of disease.

m: अव-कुण्ठन n. (= अव-गुण्ठन, q.v.) investing, surrounding, covering, Hcar.
अव-कुण्ठित mfn. invested, surrounded, L.

v: na॰ ava + kuYca lyuw । 1 AkuYcane AkuYcanaYca sat svevAvayavAnAmAramBakasaMyogezu parasparamavayavAnAmanAramBakasaMyogotpAdakaM vastrAdyavayavakOwilyotpAdakaM ca karma, yato Bavati saNkucati padmaM saNkucati vastraM saNkucati carmmota pratyayaH, tAdfSaM karmma” vE॰ sU॰ u॰ । karaRe lyuw “ataUrdDaM sarvvavadanABavanti upakramya” “todanaBedanastamBana svaprAvakuYca nANkuSikABavantIti” suSrutokte 2 rogaBede ca ।
m: अव-कुञ्चन n. curving, flexure, contraction, Suśr.
अव-√ कुत्स् to blame, revile, L.
a: अवकुत्स् — {c10c} U. To blame, revile, contemn.

m: अव-कुत्सित n. blame, censure, Nir. i, 4.
a: अवकुत्सित — p. p. Blamed, reviled &c. --तं Blame, censure.

m: अव-√ कुट् (ind.p. -कुट्य) to break or cut into pieces, Suśr.

s: avakuwAraM
klI, (ava + svArTe atiSaye vA kuwArac .) vErUpyaM । iti saMkziptasAravyAkaraRasya pariSizwaM ॥ (avAcInatvaM । vEparItyaM .)
v: tri॰ ava + svArTe atiSaye vA kuwArac atyantanimnAdO 1 avaSabdArTe 2 vErUpye na॰ ।
m: अव-कुटार mfn. (cf. अव-कट), Pāṇ. v, 2, 30.
a: अवकुटार — a. [अव-स्वार्थे अतिशये वा कुटारच्] Very deep, downwards, backwards. --रं Deformity. See अवकट.

m: अव-कुटारिका f. = अव-कटिका, q.v., L.

a: अवकुट्टित — a. 1 Vexed, inflamed. --2 Cut off.

m: अव-√ कुष् to rub downwards, L.
अव-क्वाथ m. imperfect digestion or decoction, L.
a: अवक्वाथः — Imperfect digestion or decoction.

m: अव-क्वण m. a discordant or false note, L.
a: अवक्वणः — A discordant note.

m: अव-√ कॢप् -कल्पते, to correspond to, answer, be right, TS. &c.; to be fit for, serve to (dat.), BhP.; Sarvad. : Caus., -कल्पयति, to put in order, prepare, make ready, ŚBr. &c.; to employ becomingly, ŚBr.; to consider as possible, Pāṇ. iii, 3, 147, Sch. : Desid. of Caus. (impf. 3. pl. अवाचिकल्पयिषन्) to wish to prepare or to make ready, AitBr.
a: अवकॢप् — {c1c} A. 1 To correspond with, to answer. --2 To be right or fit, to be possible; इतश्च न प्रधानस्य प्रवृत्तिरवकल्पते Ś. B. --3 To help to, to serve, to accomplish, result in (with dat.); शरीरिणां संसृतयेऽवकल्पते Bhāg. --Caus. 1 To put in order, to prepare; to make ready; संभारानवकल्पय Mb. --2 To use or employ becomingly. --3 To consider as possible; नावकल्प्यमिदंग्लायेद्यत्कृच्छ्रेषु भवानपि Bk. 19. 17; यत्तत्रभवान्वृषलं याजयेन्नावकल्पयामि P. III. 3. 147 Sk.

m: अव-कॢप्त mfn. corresponding with, right, fit, ŚBr.
(अन्- neg.), TS.; ŚBr.

v: strI ava + kfpa--kta rolaH । samBAvanAyAm “anavakxptyA marvayoH” pA॰ “anavakxptirasamBAvanA” si॰ kO॰ “kveva Bokzyase anavakxptAveva” si॰ kO॰ ।
m: अव-कॢप्ति f. considering as possible, Pāṇ. iii, 3, 145 (अन्- neg.)
a: अवकॢप्तिः — f. 1 Considering as possible, possibility, probability; क्वेव भोक्ष्येस अनवकॢप्तावेव Sk. ( अनवकॢप्तिरसंभावना). --2 Suitableness.

m: अव-क्षाण mfn. burnt down, MaitrS.; TS.
अव-क्षालन n. (√ 2. क्षल्), washing by immersion or dipping in.
अव-क्षाम mfn. (cf. Pāṇ. viii, 2, 53) meagre, lean, AV. vi, 37, 3.
a: अवक्षामः — Ved. Propitiatory offering; satisfaction of claims, compensation.

m: अव-क्षायम् ind. so as to give a blow, ĀpŚr.
अव-√ क्षै only p.p.

v: tri॰ ava + kzi--kta । 1 avakzayaprApte vinASonmuKe padArTe । BAve kta । 2 avakzaye na॰ ।
m: अव-क्षीण mfn. wasted, emaciated, L.
a: अवक्षीण — p. p. Wasted, emaciated. --णं Loss, destruction.

m: अव-√ क्ष्णु (1. sg. -क्ष्णौमि) to rub off, efface, RV. x, 23, 2.
अव-√ क्षर् Caus. (ind.p. -क्षा रयित्वा) to cause to flow down upon (acc.), ĀśvGṛ.

v: pu॰ ava + kzi--BAve ac । vfdDyuttaraM nASonmuKAyasTAyAM BAvavikAraBede ।
m: अव-क्षय m. destruction, waste, loss, L.
a: अवक्षयः — 1 Destruction, decay, waste, loss; लब्धं रक्षेदवक्षयात् H. 2. 8. --2 A kind of malady.

v: na॰ ava + kzi--Ric--BAve lyuw । avakzayasADane vyApAraBede । “brAhmaRA unmuKAvakzayaRamakrata” Sata॰ BA॰ ।
m: अव-क्षयण See अङ्गारावक्षयण.
a: अवक्षयणं — Means of extinguishing (fire &c.); as in अंगार˚.

m: अव-क्षेप m. blaming, reviling, scolding, Pāṇ. vi, 3, 73 Comm.
a: अवक्षेपः — 1 Blaming, reviling. --2 Objection.

m: अव-क्षेपणी f. bridle, L.

v: ava + kzipa--BAve lyuw । aDaHsaMyogAnukUlekriyABede । “musalamavakzipAmItIcCAjanitena prayatnena prayatnavadAtmasaMyogarUpAdasamavAmikAraRAt haste kriyA jAyate tato'vakzepaRaviSizwahastanodanAdasamavAyikAraRAt hastasaMyuktamusale'pyavakzapaRaM karmma yugapadvA jAyate” rva॰ sU॰ u॰ uktaM jYeyam । “utkzepaRamavakzepaRamAkuYcanaM prasAraRaM gamanamiti karmmARi” vEsU॰ “utkzeparRaM taTAvakzepaRamAkuYcanaM taTA । prasAraRaYca gamanaM karmmARyetAni paYca ca” BAzA॰ । BAve GaY । avakzepo'pyatrArTe । karaRe lyuw NIp । 2 balAyAmoDazO strI ।
m: अव-क्षेपण n. throwing down, overcoming, Pāṇ. i, 3, 32, &c.
reviling, blame, despising, Pāṇ. v, 3, 95 & vi, 2, 195
a: अवक्षेपणं — 1 Throwing down, considered as one of the five kinds of karman, q. v. --2 Contempt, despising; अवक्षेपणे कन् P. V. 3. 95. --3 Censure, blame; P. I. 3. 32; VI. 2. 195. --4 Overcoming, subduing. --णी Rein, bridle.

m: अव-√ क्षि (Pot. -क्षिणुयात्) to remove, Lāṭy.; Kauś. : Pass. -क्षीयते, to waste away, L.
a: अवक्षि — {c1c} {c5c} {c9c} P. To remove, carry off, destroy. --Pass. To waste away, decay.

m: अव-√ क्षिप् -क्षिपति (Subj. -क्षि पत्, RV. iv, 27, 3; p. -क्षिपत् mfn., RV. x, 68, 4) to throw down, cause to fly down or away, hurl, RV. &c.; to revile, MBh. ii, 1337 (v.l. अप for अव); to grant, yield, MBh. xiii, 3030. Caus. (aor. Subj. 3. pl. -चिक्षिपन्) to cause to fall down, AV. xviii, 4, 12 and 13.
a: अवक्षिप् — {c6c} U. 1 To fling away, to throw or cast off; सूक्ष्मवस्त्रमवक्षिप्य मुनिवस्त्राण्यवस्त ह Rām.; to hurl. --2 To cause to fly down or away. --3 To reprimand, revile any one, censure, slander; मदलेखामवक्षिप्य K. 317; अवाक्षिपद्वासुदेवं Mb. --4 To grant, yield. --Caus. To cause to fall down.

v: tri॰ ava + kzipa--karmmaRi kta । kftAvakzepe vastuni yasyAvakzepaH kftastasmin ।
m: अव-क्षिप्त mfn. thrown down
said sarcastically, imputed, insinuated, L.
blamed, reviled, L.
a: अवक्षिप्त — p. p. 1 Thrown down; badly thrown. --2 Said sarcastically, imputed, insinuated. --3 Reviled, censured, blamed.
अवक्षु — {c2c} P. To sneeze upon.

m: अव-√ क्षुद् (ind.p. -क्षुद्य) to stamp or pound or rub to pieces, Suśr.

s: avakzutaM
klI, (ava + kza + kta .) uparikftakzutaM । yaTA manuH, -- “dvizadannaM nagaryyannaM patitAnnamavakzutaM” । ityAhnikatattvaM ॥
v: tri॰ ava + kzu--kta । upari kftakzute । yasyopari kzutaM kftaM tasmin । “dvizadannaM nagaryyannaM patitAnnamavakzutam” manuH ।
m: अव-क्षुत mfn. sneezed upon, Mn. iv, 213 and v, 125; MBh. xiii, 4367.
a: अवक्षुत — p. p. Sneezed upon; द्विषदन्नं नगर्यन्नं पतितान्नमवक्षुतं Ms. 4. 213.
